title: Partition of the regular set of a map ℝᵏ → ℝ^{N'} into countably many Borel pieces on which it is bi-Lipschitz (Simon Ch. 3, 1.2–1.3; the partition argument of steps 2 and 7 of the selected proof)
statement: Let k, N' ∈ ℕ, H : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{N'} any map and B ⊆ ℝᵏ Borel. Then there are Borel sets A_l ⊆ B (l ∈ ℕ), pairwise disjoint, and constants κ_l > 0 such that κ_l|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ A_l, H is differentiable with injective derivative at every point of every A_l, and every u ∈ B at which H is differentiable with injective derivative belongs to some A_l.
lean_statement: ∀ (k N' : ℕ) (H : Euclid k → Euclid N') (B : Set (Euclid k)), MeasurableSet B → ∃ (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid k)) (κ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ l, MeasurableSet (A l)) ∧ (∀ l, A l ⊆ B) ∧ Pairwise (fun l l' => Disjoint (A l) (A l')) ∧ (∀ l, 0 < κ l) ∧ (∀ l, ∀ a ∈ A l, ∀ a' ∈ A l, κ l * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) ∧ (∀ l, ∀ a ∈ A l, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) ∧ ∀ u ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H u → Injective (fderiv ℝ H u) → ∃ l, u ∈ A l
